ValidationRule.description: Ensures request options and parent relationships cannot be modified after insertion.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(Job__c), ISCHANGED(Document_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Language__c), ISCHANGED(Template_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Context_Strategy__c), ISCHANGED(Allow_Unavailable_Job__c), ISCHANGED(Predecessor_Request__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Creation inputs (Job, Document Type, Language, Template ID, Context Strategy, Allow Unavailable Job, Predecessor) cannot be modified after insertion.
